cmapss_fd001.dataset: NASA C-MAPSS FD001: 100 turbofan engines, run-to-failure sensor histories
caveats: FD001 covers a single operating condition and a single fault mode.
Lead times are in engine cycles, not wall-clock time.

cwru.dataset: CWRU bearing vibration: normal baselines plus seeded inner-race, ball, and outer-race faults
caveats: 0.5 second non-overlapping windows; threshold at 99th percentile of baseline.
Held-out normal file: 1 of 20 windows flagged (5% false positive rate).

method: Unsupervised throughout. Labels used only for scoring, never for training.
